summary: Tested Excel/CSV Export/Import for sauna prices and dealer overrides (iteration 85). 15/15 backend pytest cases passed including auth gating, xlsx/csv export, dealer-scoped export, dry-run unchanged/modified/empty/invalid file, commit with revert, dealer-override upsert, and empty-dealerPrice no-op. Frontend verified: Export/Import buttons mounted in Sauna Pricing page and Dealers admin page; dry-run dialog renders with summary chips, diff rows, hide-unchanged toggle, and dynamic 'Применить (N)' button.
critical_code_review_comments: diff_rows duplicate-key handling decrements 'unchanged' counter only conditionally — when duplicate appears AFTER first being counted as added/modified the counter is not reverted (minor; will under-report errors when duplicates exist). Consider tracking the prior status to revert correctly.

Export of options omits the 'category' column when option lives at top level (flat options[]). This is intentional (parentId=''), but worth documenting in the file header comment for dealer-facing imports.

apply_rows ignores rows whose `parentId` points to a missing category for new options — silently increments error counter. Consider returning structured row-level errors from commit similar to dry-run for parity.
sauna_excel.py is 700 lines — close to the file-size threshold; consider splitting export/diff/apply into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: Test created and then reverted one model basePrice via xlsx round-trip; created and removed a dealer-price override for testdealer (set to 99999 then test_commit_empty_dealerprice_is_noop ran with blanks — override remains at 99999 in DB after test run; main agent may want to clear if needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sauna Excel/CSV import/export endpoints under /api/sauna/prices/{export,import/dry-run,import/commit}. Admin auth required (Bearer). Export with ?dealerId=... adds 'dealerPrice' as 11th column. Dry-run never writes; commit upserts base prices doc and dealer_price_overrides only for rows with non-empty dealerPrice. UI: PriceImportExport.jsx is mounted on SaunaPricingPage header, DealersAdminPage header, and inside DealerPricesDialog. Russian-labeled buttons in UI: 'Экспорт' / 'Импорт'. data-testids: export-prices-btn, import-prices-btn, export-xlsx, export-csv, import-file-input, dry-run-dialog, dry-run-commit, dry-run-cancel, hide-unchanged-toggle, diff-row-{added|modified|unchanged|error}. Verified flows: xlsx round-trip (no changes => unchanged), modified xlsx row produces 'modified' status with price diff old/new, CSV with new model + bad type → 1 added + 1 error in dry-run dialog. Dealer override upsert and no-op-on-empty verified via API tests.
rca of the issue: No issues found — feature complete and behaves per spec.
